Overview

The hidden cost of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for 3PL & Freight Forwarding is never the model; it is the scaffolding — data contracts, evaluation harnesses, rollback machinery, audit evidence. We price and build that scaffolding explicitly, on TMS execution, because that is where programs actually succeed or die. The Logistics & Supply Chain operating reality gives this work its shape: dwell time pressure at event speed, GDPR / privacy regimes obligations on every artifact, and practitioners who will not accept recommendations they cannot interrogate. The pattern below is calibrated to those three forces.
